text: Given the normal sweat chloride and contrast enema, Hirschsprung disease remains a strong possibility despite the ambiguous imaging. I will proceed with a rectal suction biopsy to definitively rule out aganglionic segments. REQUEST TEST: Rectal Suction Biopsy
